justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: 68% mortality reduction is striking; ICU-acquired weakness reduction is durable. Delirium days reduced meaningfully.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Institutional in-service training; low to no cost; can be completed quickly; widely available.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable specifically in ICU and acute care settings; zero applicability in outpatient or community care.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: ICU care quality measure support; early mobility billed under acute care codes; no specific CPT but supports documentation.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Strong demand in ICU and acute care PT/OT roles; standard expectation in Level I trauma and medical ICU positions.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: ICU population limited in self-report; family-reported experience improved; PTSD reduction documented.
justifications.research.methodologyDepth: Bundle training is grounded in implementation science methods and audit-and-feedback methodology.
justifications.research.publicationTrack: Implementation outcomes in ICU bundles are an active, publishable research line.
justifications.research.grantReadiness: Aligns with AHRQ and NHLBI implementation-science funding priorities.
justifications.research.pathwayToIndependence: Useful domain but not a standalone path to PI status.
justifications.research.interdisciplinaryFit: Inherently multi-professional (PT/OT/RT/RN/MD) and well-suited to team science.
justifications.research.efficiency: Low training cost relative to research-domain entry it provides.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: ICU patients don't pay cash for rehab; entirely hospital/insurance domain.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: No pricing leverage outside hospital employment.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Doesn't support a scalable private business.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Strong for acute care/CCS-aligned faculty; less weight outside acute tracks.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: SCCM-backed with robust ICU liberation literature.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Core content for acute care and cardiopulmonary curricula.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong RCT and implementation-science evidence base.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Preferred for acute-care faculty lines; niche otherwise.
